profile.headline: Passionate software developer looking to use his skills to impact the world in a positive way.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: I develop, debug, document and maintain MVC web applications that use industry standard frameworks such as Bootstrap and jQuery to improve business workflows. I develop C# console applications to convert third-party vender data to Oracle specific load data as well as custom data integration extracts from Oracle that follow vendor requirements. I design and manage the relational databases  in Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio for MVC and console applications I have developed. I work closely with users to create and maintain Microsoft SharePoint 2016 and SharePoint online sites. I develop SharePoint workflows on lists and libraries. I troubleshoot, problem solve, research, evaluate, and provide feedback on problematic trends and patterns in customer support requirements for SharePoint issues. I have developed and maintained problem tracking and resolution databases. I operate Axway Secure Transport FTP server to securely push and pull medical data files to and from health care partners. This includes the transfer of Personal Identifiable Information (PII). I install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain customer software. I diagnose and resolve incident tickets by email, phone, or in person involving systems and applications for the following programs: Axway Secure Transport, SharePoint, and MVC web applications. I work 24 hours on-call shifts to provide the hospital with 24-hour Information Technology customer support.  I evaluate system performance data to identify and address inefficiencies, identify problems, ascertain root cause, impact, and provide recommendations for resolution. I work with an attention to detail, while providing excellent customer service with effective oral and written communication skills.

positions.title: MIS Intern
positions.description: I worked incident tickets involving SharePoint Microsoft SharePoint 2013 and SharePoint online sites.  I worked closely with users to create and maintain Microsoft SharePoint 2013. I developed SharePoint workflows on lists and libraries. I troubleshot/problem solved SharePoint issues. I evaluated system performance data to identify and address inefficiencies, identify problems, ascertain root cause and its impact to the systems, and providing recommendations for resolution. Responsible for the editing and maintenance of html pages and performed other duties as assigned.

positions.title: Computer Software Trainer
positions.description: Worked with students to debug their programs. Provided training as needed to assist other students in software applications.  Reinforced good programming techniques taught in the classroom. Held extended program training sessions outside of class.
